name: Femdom City M.A.N.T.I.S.
source:
Femdom City is a fictional place run by an autocratic government, where women are superior to the inferior males. Males in this place look a bit smaller than usual and have less muscles. Males have to help restore the partly destroyed city, that’s why they usually have to take on jobs that serve women in order to be able to pay the higher taxes for males.

Different fractions are now trying to gain more influence over the City. A street gang in downtown has teamed up with the Futanari, a group of powerful tall females that have both male and female genitals. Together they run large parts of Downtown. The police keeps the focus on Uptown and the Middletown District, where big companies like FemmeCorp and The Rubberfactory run the show and official buildings like the administration and the school are located. There are many other fractions that don’t fall in any category. The Church of Kink for example, a group of dominant nuns that are living under their own commandments. Or mayor Beatrix de Jaager and her government that has recently adopted some very strange laws to ensure female supremacy in Femdom City. She seems to have big plans. Maybe you can uncover the secrets and find out more about her and the mysterious organisation called MANTIS.

You are one of these males, trying to survive in this city that is so hostile towards you that every day is a challenge. How did it get this far? Was Femdom City always the place that it is now? Will you manage to escape the city or will you find a mistress that will treat you right? Will you uncover the secret places of Femdom City and maybe manage to make a rather decent living as a submissive male / slave?

[From [url=https://darktoz.itch.io/femdom-city-mantis]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
调教城是一个虚构的地方，由专制政府管理，女性地位高于劣等男性。这个地方的男性看起来比平时要小一些，肌肉也更少。男性必须帮助恢复部分被毁的城市，这就是为什么他们通常必须承担为女性服务的工作，以便能够为男性支付更高的税收。

不同的派系现在正试图对伦敦金融城获得更大的影响力。市中心的一个街头帮派与扶他（Futanari）组织合作，这是一群强大的高个子女性，拥有男性和女性生殖器。他们共同管理着市中心的大部分地区。警方将重点放在上城区和米德尔敦区，那里有FemmeCorp和The Rubberfactory等大公司负责运营，还有行政部门和学校等官方建筑。还有许多其他分数不属于任何类别。例如，奇想教会，一群在自己的戒律下生活的占主导地位的修女。或者市长Beatrix de Jaager和她的政府最近通过了一些非常奇怪的法律来确保女性主导城市的女性至上。她似乎有很大的计划。也许你可以揭开秘密，了解更多关于她和名为“螳螂”的神秘组织的信息。

你是这些男性中的一员，试图在这座对你充满敌意的城市中生存，每天都是一个挑战。怎么走到这一步了？调教城一直都是现在这个地方吗？你会设法逃离这座城市，还是会找到一个善待你的情妇？你会发现调教之城的秘密地点，并可能作为顺从的男性/奴隶过上相当体面的生活吗？
